blocked: Your browser has blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the address bar first.

default.label: Notify me about, in {{name}}

descriptions.all: Every new message in your channels, plus mentions, replies and direct messages.
descriptions.mentions: Direct messages, mentions and replies in threads you follow.
descriptions.nothing: Only direct messages. Channels stay quiet until you open them.

default.override: A channel can override this from its bell menu. Direct messages notify you unless you change them one by one.
default.saveFailed: Couldn't change your notification default. Try again.

keywords.label: My keywords
keywords.hint: You are notified when one of these is written in a channel you are in, as if you had been mentioned. Press Enter to add one.
keywords.saveFailed: Couldn't save your keywords. Try again.

problems.prefix: A keyword cannot start with @ or #.
problems.limit: You can keep up to {{limit}} keywords.

schedule.label: Notification schedule
schedule.description: Outside these hours notifications wait in Notifications instead of reaching you.
schedule.timezone: Times are in {{timezone}}, the timezone in your profile.
schedule.saveFailed: Couldn't save your schedule. Try again.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.on: On. Mentions reach you with the app closed; do not disturb and muted channels still apply.
push.off: Off. Mentions only arrive while a window is open.
push.stopped: This device will stop receiving notifications.
push.refused: Your browser refused notification permission for this site.

desktop.title: Desktop notifications while the app is open
desktop.on: On. A message that notifies you shows on the desktop while this window is not in front.
desktop.off: Off. An open window only plays a sound and updates Notifications.

email.title: Email me what I missed
email.on: On. A mention or direct message still unread five minutes later is emailed once, with a link to it.
email.off: Off. Unread mentions wait in Notifications until you open the app.

activity.guestEndingBody: Their access ends on {{date}}. Move or clear the date in Workspace settings → Members.
